items.label_zh: 廉洁自律
items.label_en: Integrity and self-discipline (statutory deputy duty)
items.note: Representative Law Art. 8(7). Public duty category. Not an asset register. Amounts not collected.

items.label_zh: 自觉接受监督
items.label_en: Duty to accept supervision
items.note: Representative Law Art. 57. Public duty category. No dollars.

items.label_zh: 向原选区选民或者原选举单位报告履职情况
items.label_en: Report duty performance to the original electoral district or unit
items.note: Representative Law Art. 58. Public report duty. Not a financial-disclosure filing.

items.label_zh: 公示代表基本信息和履职信息
items.label_en: Publicize deputies' basic information and duty-performance information
items.note: Representative Law Art. 58. Local standing committees publicize basic and duty-performance information, not asset categories. No public NPC financial-disclosure register.

items.label_zh: 正确处理从事个人职业活动与执行代表职务的关系
items.label_en: Keep personal occupation separate from performance of deputy duties
items.note: Representative Law Art. 59. Public conduct category. No dollars. No named private holdings.

items.label_zh: 不得利用执行代表职务干预具体执法、司法案件
items.label_en: Must not use deputy office to interfere in specific law-enforcement or judicial cases
items.note: Representative Law Art. 59. Public prohibition. No confidential annex.

items.label_zh: 不得插手招标投标等经济活动
items.label_en: Must not use deputy office to intervene in bidding or other economic activities
items.note: Representative Law Art. 59. Public prohibition. Named private counterparties not collected.

items.label_zh: 不得变相从事商业活动牟取个人利益
items.label_en: Must not use deputy office for disguised commercial activity for personal gain
items.note: Representative Law Art. 59. Public prohibition. No dollars. No named private donors.

items.label_zh: 模范地遵守宪法和法律
items.label_en: Play an exemplary role in observing the Constitution and the law
items.note: Representative Law Art. 8(1). Public duty category. No amounts.

items.label_zh: 保守国家秘密
items.label_en: Keep state secrets (statutory deputy duty)
items.note: Representative Law Art. 8(1). Public duty category. Not a confidential annex and not an asset register.

items.label_zh: 按时出席本级人民代表大会会议
items.label_en: Attend sessions of the people's congress at the corresponding level on time
items.note: Representative Law Art. 8(2) / Art. 13. Public attendance duty. No dollars.

items.label_zh: 遵守会议纪律
items.label_en: Observe session discipline
items.note: Representative Law Art. 8(2). Public conduct category. No amounts.

items.label_zh: 与原选区选民或者原选举单位和人民群众保持密切联系
items.label_en: Maintain close contact with original electors or electoral units and the people
items.note: Representative Law Art. 8(6). Public duty category. No named private counterparties.

items.label_zh: 遵守议事规则
items.label_en: Observe the rules of procedure when speaking to the session agenda
items.note: Representative Law Art. 14. Public conduct category. No dollars.

items.label_zh: 不直接处理问题
items.label_en: Must not directly handle issues while inspecting or conducting special surveys
items.note: Representative Law Art. 31. Public prohibition during inspection/survey. No confidential annex.

items.label_zh: 年度代表工作计划向社会公布
items.label_en: Publish the annual deputy-work plan to the public
items.note: Representative Law Art. 43. Public disclosure of the standing-committee annual deputy-work plan. Not an asset register.

items.label_zh: 代表建议、批评和意见办理情况的报告应当予以公开
items.label_en: Publish reports on the handling of deputies' suggestions, criticisms, and opinions
items.note: Representative Law Art. 51. Public disclosure of suggestion-handling reports. No RMB amounts.

items.label_zh: 加强思想作风建设
items.label_en: Strengthen ideological and work-style construction
items.note: Representative Law Art. 57. Public conduct category. Not a financial-disclosure filing.

items.label_zh: 自觉维护代表形象
items.label_en: Consciously uphold the image of deputies
items.note: Representative Law Art. 57. Public conduct category. No dollars.

items.label_zh: 回答原选区选民或者原选举单位对代表工作和代表活动的询问
items.label_en: Answer inquiries from original electors or electoral units about deputy work and activities
items.note: Representative Law Art. 58. Public accountability/disclosure duty. Not an asset category.

items.label_zh: 应当记录代表履职情况
items.label_en: Standing bodies shall record deputies' duty-performance information
items.note: Representative Law Art. 58. Public record of duty performance, not a financial-disclosure register.

items.label_zh: 选民或者选举单位有权依法罢免自己选出的代表
items.label_en: Electors or electoral units may lawfully recall the deputies they elected
items.note: Representative Law Art. 60. Public supervision/recall category. No amounts.

items.label_zh: 未经批准两次不出席本级人民代表大会会议的，其代表资格终止
items.label_en: Deputy qualification terminates after two unexcused absences from sessions
items.note: Representative Law Art. 62(3). Public qualification-termination ground. No confidential annex.

items.label_zh: 责令辞职被接受的，其代表资格终止
items.label_en: Deputy qualification terminates when an ordered resignation is accepted
items.note: Representative Law Art. 62(2). Public qualification-termination ground. No dollars.

items.label_zh: 因健康等特殊原因不能出席会议的，应当按照规定请假
items.label_en: Apply for leave according to the rules if unable to attend a session
items.note: Representative Law Art. 13. Public attendance/leave duty. No amounts.

items.label_zh: 忠实代表人民的利益和意志
items.label_en: Faithfully represent the interests and will of the people
items.note: Representative Law Art. 5. Public duty category. No named private donors.
